name: rally.raid Earth Rally
description: EXPERIMENTAL rally mode for rally.raid Earth: load a multi-day rally file, see the day list, choose to DRIVE each liaison against its time allowance or TELEPORT (the whole allowance counts as used), follow the cumulative rally time with penalties, and get unused liaison time added to the evening bivouac (repairs in the Repair app). Buttons only; no default keys.
author: wyans (rally.raid Earth)
